verdict.rationale: Opting out of a product's own telemetry is a fair privacy question for a self-hostable data platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack never mentions Jitsu's own telemetry or any opt-out setting. Self-hosting and on-prem deployment (jitsu-docs-14, jitsu-docs-56) and event filtering via Functions concern the customer's pipeline data, not opting out of vendor usage tracking, so they cannot be credited here.
